== valid gamertag
"Player" yes
"Player One" yes
"a" yes
"abcdefghijklmno" yes
"abcdefghijklmnop" no
"" no
" Lead" no
"Trail " no
"under_score" yes
"dash-name" yes
"dot.name" no
"Umlaut\xc3\xa4" no
"tab	name" no
== load gamertag
missing -> (none)
"Player\n" -> Player
"Player\r\n" -> Player
"Player" -> Player
"Second\nLine two\n" -> Second
" Bad\n" -> (none)
"" -> (none)
"\n" -> (none)
== save gamertag
invalid: error invalid_gamertag path=(none) detail=""
  message: Enter a valid gamertag first (1-15 chars: letters, numbers, spaces, _ or -, no leading/trailing space).
valid: ok
file: "Player One\n"
again: ok
file: "Player Two\n"
== write and read bytes
write into missing folders: ok
read back equal: yes
read missing: error avatar_unreadable path=<root>/missing.bin detail="cannot open file"
  message: Cannot read <root>/missing.bin: cannot open file
== write file atomically
replace: ok
file: "new"
into a missing folder: write error
keeps permissions: yes
through a symlink: ok, link kept: yes, target: "new"
over a folder with files: replace error
== prepare data folder
data next to the install: ok
separate, first run: ok
config: "shipped = true\n"
separate, again: ok
config: "edited = true\n"
== resolve content folder
"(none)" -> <root>/data/content
"content" -> <root>/data/content
"packages/360" -> <root>/data/packages/360
"<root>/elsewhere" -> <root>/elsewhere
